learnings: Code execution is funneled through a single CodeExecutionQueue singleton (maxConcurrency=4) to bound Docker container load.
Runtime is measured inside the container via an __RUNTIME__ marker to exclude Docker/interpreter overhead.
Orphan Node processes holding port 3000 can cause silent app.listen failures in nodemon resulting in 404s for newly merged routes.
Added server.on('error', EADDRINUSE) in backend/src/app.ts to immediately detect port conflicts.
